title: Acceleration time expression
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the correct expression for time t, incorporating the number of acceleration cycles and magnetic period.

title: Electrode thickness derivation
description: Important: Student must correctly relate maximum thickness to the difference in radii of the last two semicircular orbits before extraction.

title: Maximum radius calculation
description: Essential: Student must derive the final expression for R_m using geometry of the deflector and force balance in the slit.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply energy conservation to relate kinetic energy at P to acceleration voltage and number of cycles.

title: Force balance in deflector
description: Important: Student must set up correct force balance (Lorentz minus electric) for circular motion within the deflector slit.

title: Geometric relationships
description: Important: Student must correctly use geometry (triangle OO'Q) to relate deflector radius to magnetic field radius.

title: Cyclotron period usage
description: Optional: Student may explicitly state or use the period T = 2πm/(qB) in time calculation.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly adds electric and magnetic forces instead of subtracting (since fields oppose for extraction).

title: Incorrect acceleration count
description: Pitfall: Student miscalculates number of acceleration cycles (n = qB²R²/(2mU) - 1) for time expression.
